items.t: Does AbbVie (ABBV) Need This New Solid Tumor Cancer Partnership?
items.sum: AbbVie (NYSE:ABBV) and DISCO Pharmaceuticals announced a new collaboration to develop bispecific cancer therapies for solid tumors. The agreement focuses on applying DISCO Pharmaceuticals' proprietary bispecific technology platform to AbbVie's oncology research programs.
